narrative.details:
My brother Morgan is waiting in Stormwind for my shipment of candles.  I don't have enough time to make the trip myself, but if you'd like to take him the shipment, he'll pay you well.

I've packed up the candles, and you can find Morgan in our shop, Pestle's Apothecary, in the Stormwind Trade District.
narrative.objectives: Bring William's Shipment to Morgan Pestle in the Stormwind Trade District.
narrative.offerRewardText: Here is your payment ... and while you're here, take a look around! I'm sure we have a potion or other trinket you'd find useful.
narrative.requestItemsText: Oh, a shipment from my brother? Splendid! Fortune truly shines on me today!
